correctness.rationale: The proof tracks all equality cases in the source lower-envelope argument. A strict version of the auxiliary W-polynomial bound gives uniqueness on every cell k>=3 and only the adjacent tie at xi_k; the source's explicit low-degree factorizations and strict high-degree margins show that the only extra tie in the first two cells is the Legendre degree-5 equality at x=-1/3.

originality.rationale: Castillo--Sadigova arXiv:2609.15473 proves the lower-envelope values and exhibits the Legendre 1,2,5 tie but does not classify all minimising indices. De Oliveira Filho's thesis poses the arbitrary-minimizer monotonicity question. Targeted literature and SCOPE searches found no equivalent complete equality-case classification; residual risk from very recent unindexed work is retained.

value.rationale: The theorem completely determines minimizer multiplicities for the ultraspherical lower envelope and shows that the known Legendre counterexample is the unique obstruction to de Oliveira Filho's Question 1, strengthening a recent complete envelope theorem in a mathematically meaningful way.
